summary.text: Tommy Vitolo is a Democratic state representative from the 15th Norfolk District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He worked as an expert witness before taking office and holds a Ph.D. from Boston University.

paragraphs.text: Tommy Vitolo was born in Western Connecticut.

He earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University, a master's degree from Dublin City University, and a Ph.D. from Boston University, and his career experience includes working as an expert witness.
Vitolo took office on January 2, 2019, succeeding Frank Smizik.

He is vice chair of the Joint Committee on Labor and Workforce Development and also serves on the Joint Committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity, on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, and on Health Care Financing.
